audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level rows named a side that its own 'why' text contradicts. whys[2] and whys[3] describe Akshan denying the third mark and out-poking from outside stun range, yet the rows read Kennen/Skill; whys[4] says 'you win the all-in' on a Skill row; whys[5] says he survives your R window on a Kennen row.
audit.why: Heroic Swing arrives at 3 and its kite range is what breaks the Mark of the Storm chain; Kennen retakes the lane only at 6 with Slicing Maelstrom, and Akshan's camo and revive carry him through the 120s gap between Maelstroms. The packet levelChart matches this reading exactly.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kennen / Skill / Akshan / Akshan / Kennen / Akshan / Kennen in both layers, with phases[2].why, phases[3].why and phases[5].why rewritten to state the real reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried no cooldown numbers at all, and phases[5].why claimed the first-item window as Kennen's when the content layer says the opposite.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, Avengerang 9/8/7/6/5, Comeuppance 100/85/70, Slicing Maelstrom a flat 120. The 18s rank-1 swing is the number that defines when you may commit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the real numbers; report[5].t and phases[2]/[5].why now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named only Heroic Swing — never Dirty Fighting, Avengerang, Going Rogue or Comeuppance — and never mentioned his passive shield or the fact that Kennen has no dash to answer a cut-off.
audit.why: Dirty Fighting shields Akshan on every third hit from his attacks and abilities, which eats the front of your burst before the third Mark of the Storm lands. Kennen's only repositioning tool is Lightning Rush (10/9/8/7/6s), which passes through units but is not a dash out of a terrain cut — Flash is.
audit.corrected: report[5].t states the Dirty Fighting shield and the 18s swing; dontsFull[0].d states the no-dash / hold-Flash rule; dontsFull[1].d prices Electrical Surge at 13s.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your range.
edits.after: Heroic Swing lands at 3 and its 18s kite range dodges your Q, so the third Mark of the Storm stops connecting.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Swing's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Heroic Swing skirmishes your short cooldowns and Avengerang chips you from outside stun range. Farm, do not contest.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: His item spike beats yours here — camo and the swing let him survive the 120s gap between Maelstroms.

edits.before: Shuriken Akshan's last-hits, weave an AA mark, and stun on the third proc when his answer is down.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken his last-hits, weave an Electrical Surge mark, stun on the third before he swings out.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s maxed — his escape and his re-entry. - Avengerang: 9s, hits going out and coming back. - Comeuppance: 100s at rank 1, missing-health damage. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s flat, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — 3-stun rotation + R dive.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit — chip it off before you commit. Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1; that is your window.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Hold Flash for his Heroic Swing cut-off, not for damage — you have no dash.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Electrical Surge is 13s at rank 1 — no W means no third mark.

notes: Both packet suspectNames ('Land Thundering Shuriken', 'Use Lightning Rush') are FALSE POSITIVES — those are Kennen's real Q and E names and the content layer uses them correctly. Going Rogue's derived 'terrain' flag is not supported by Riot's description (camouflage plus move speed and mana regen toward Scoundrels), so no terrain claim was made about W; the retreat-cut warning is attributed to Heroic Swing only. The content layer was already accurate and was left alone apart from the six level-chart rows, each flipped in a matched pair with the full layer to land on the packet's chart.
